name: Hasebe Yumiko
source: Elegantly beautiful, have excellent grades, and a woman held in high regard by men and women alike. Those traits make her seem unrelated to prostitution, but in actuality, she humps middle-aged men. She socializes only for keeping good outward appearances. She will only open her heart to those who try to get to know the real her.
